# Syntalix Consultancy — Full Company and Services Description

> Syntalix Consultancy (legally registered as Syntalix LLP) is an India-based software and AI/ML development company serving businesses across India, the United States, UAE, Australia, and the United Kingdom.

## Company Overview

Syntalix Consultancy is a technology firm founded in 2023, specialising in enterprise software development, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and large language model engineering. The company operates as Syntalix LLP, a registered Limited Liability Partnership in India.

Contact: syntalix.consultancy@gmail.com | +91-9259750107
Website: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com

## Services

### AI & ML Infrastructure
Syntalix builds custom AI and ML infrastructure for enterprises. Services include: custom ML model development and training, MLOps pipeline setup and automation, model deployment and monitoring, data pipeline engineering, feature store design, and cloud-based AI infrastructure on AWS, GCP, and Azure.

Use cases: demand forecasting, fraud detection, recommendation engines, anomaly detection, NLP pipelines, computer vision systems.

URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/ai-ml-infrastructure

### LLM Engineering
Syntalix provides end-to-end LLM engineering services including: LLM integration via OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini and open-source models, fine-tuning of domain-specific language models, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) system design and implementation, prompt engineering, LLM API development, and LLM evaluation frameworks.

Use cases: enterprise knowledge bases, AI-powered customer support, document intelligence, legal and compliance automation, HR automation.

URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/llm-engineering

### Agentic AI Systems
Syntalix designs and builds autonomous agentic AI systems including: multi-agent orchestration using frameworks like LangGraph and AutoGen, tool-use agents with API and database integration, autonomous workflow automation, decision engines, and AI agents for research, data extraction, and business process automation.

Use cases: automated research agents, business process automation, AI-powered sales assistants, autonomous monitoring and alerting systems.

URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/agentic-systems

### Web & Mobile App Development
Syntalix delivers full-stack enterprise web and mobile applications including: Next.js and React web applications, React Native cross-platform mobile apps, iOS and Android native apps, SaaS platform development, REST and GraphQL API development, e-commerce platforms, and enterprise dashboards.

Use cases: SaaS products, enterprise internal tools, client portals, e-commerce platforms, AI-powered web apps.

URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/web-mobile-development
